tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The page, the slide, and the only button background at rest. Also the text color on reverse-video fills (pressed controls, selected chips).

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: The lifted fill: diagram nodes, terminal and event-log blocks, input fields, blocker blocks. Never a button state. Slack text on the well is 5.20:1.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Box-drawing rules (a row of ─) only. Never text, never a component border.

tokens.name: dim-line
tokens.usage: Diagram-only structure: outlines of empty progress cells and of unselected adapter chips. 1.85:1 on ground, below the 3:1 floor for meaningful marks, kept exact from the deck; always pair it with a label or with filled cells that carry the meaning.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Default text, node labels, headings in body copy, the 2px button and chip outline, and the fill of a pressed or selected control. 16.83:1 on ground, 14.9:1 on well.

tokens.name: slack
tokens.usage: Everything that recedes: eyebrows, captions, kv keys, pending [ ] steps, footers, connector strokes, dashed plugin chips, disabled controls. 5.92:1 on ground, 5.20:1 on well.

tokens.name: title
tokens.usage: Headlines and display type in the broadcast register; the repository name in the operator masthead. 12.26:1 on ground. Shares its value with warn.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Provisional [~] steps, PAUSED and ESCALATED status words, `ab escalate`, OFF toggles. Text on ground.

tokens.name: live
tokens.usage: Current [>] step, QUEUED status, links, hover, focus ring and caret, and the solid agent-writes connector. 8.93:1 on ground.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Done [x] steps and their progress cells, RUNNING status, merged, `ab done`. 8.61:1 on ground.

tokens.name: alert
tokens.usage: BLOCKED and FAILED status, failure loops in diagrams (dashed), red ! message lines, destructive confirmations. 6.13:1 on ground.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: cell-sm
styles.usage: Product UI below 720px. The one cell: every line of the dashboard, nothing larger.

styles.name: cell-lg
styles.sample: intake ON   auto merge OFF   harvest ON

styles.name: cell-bold
styles.usage: Masthead, slugs, STATUS words, the current step, section headings. Same size as the cell: emphasis is weight and role color, never size.

styles.name: web-display
styles.usage: The hero line on a marketing page, once per page, in title. Drops to web-headline size below 720px.

styles.name: web-headline
styles.usage: Section titles, in title. Below 720px use 28px / 36px.

styles.name: web-statement
styles.sample: Kill anything. It resumes from the log.
styles.usage: The one-line takeaway under a diagram, in ink.

styles.name: web-lead
styles.sample: Every build runs headless, so ten tickets in flight cost the same attention as one.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a headline, in ink, max 64ch.

styles.name: web-body
styles.sample: An independent reviewer approves the plan or sends it back with findings.
styles.usage: Running text, max 72ch. Same as the operator cell-lg.

styles.name: web-label
styles.usage: Diagram node labels, chip labels, button labels.

styles.name: web-eyebrow
styles.usage: The kicker above a section title, in slack, lowercase, with a middle dot separator. Also captions and diagram annotations.

styles.name: slide-display
styles.usage: One word or two on a 1920x1080 slide, in title.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: Slide title, in title, at x=128 y=168 on the 1920 canvas.

styles.name: slide-statement
styles.sample: The kernel never reads what an agent prints.
styles.usage: The takeaway line near the foot of a slide, in ink.

styles.name: slide-body
styles.sample: $ ab verdict revise   structured findings, not prose
styles.usage: Body lines, terminal and event-log rows, chip labels (700).

styles.name: slide-label
styles.usage: Diagram node labels on a slide.

styles.name: slide-eyebrow
styles.usage: Eyebrow above the title, footers, captions, in slack.

tokens.name: ch
tokens.usage: One character cell (1ch of JetBrains Mono). Horizontal gaps between glyph tokens; button side padding.

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: 2ch. The gap between words that belong together, and the indent per nesting level.

tokens.name: row
tokens.usage: One row at the 1280px cell. Every vertical measure in product UI is a whole row (20px below 720px, 22px to 1279px).

tokens.name: block
tokens.usage: Two rows. Between a headline and its diagram, between diagram and statement line on web.

tokens.name: section
tokens.usage: Four rows. Between marketing sections on web; 64px below 720px.

tokens.name: frame-max
tokens.usage: 160ch. The widest any frame or page column gets.

tokens.name: reading-max
tokens.usage: 80ch. Composers and long running text in product UI; web body copy caps at 72ch.

tokens.name: slide-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin on the 1920x1080 slide canvas.

tokens.name: none
tokens.usage: Every corner. There is no other radius.

stroke.note: Line weights shared by controls and diagrams.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: The one border width: buttons, adapter chips, the focus ring, connectors.

tokens.name: dash
tokens.usage: Dash pattern for runner-written events, plugin chips, and failure loops (SVG stroke-dasharray 6 4).

tokens.name: underline
tokens.usage: Hover underline under a ghost word, 0.2em above the bottom edge.
